I'd found the same little slab of plumbing copy-pasted between two pieces — the bit that decides whether a slowly-growing piece should animate on its own page or quietly grow-then-settle in its gallery thumbnail (the gallery's a bit fiddly: it only ever paints one frame, so a simulation there has to drive its own animation or it freezes at the very start).
